orchard_arrival.title: The Quiet Orchard
orchard_arrival.text:
Beyond the kitchen, pear trees lean over the little station. A handcart stands on the narrow track. Its driver shifts a folded coat to make room. A path follows the rails; a bench rests under the station awning.

The train will be here when it is here. The workers carry on at the packing shed. All three places are yours for a while.

orchard_rest_0.title: Under the pear trees
orchard_rest_0.text: The handcart wheels, the path and the station bench share the same view: pear trees, the packing shed, the long window of a waiting train. Nothing here needs finishing.

orchard_rest_1.title: Under the pear trees
orchard_rest_1.text: A pear drops from a low branch. It lands in the grass with a small, solid sound. A worker glances over, then goes back to stacking the wooden boxes.

orchard_rest_2.title: Under the pear trees
orchard_rest_2.text: Two workers cross the distant doorway of the packing shed. One carries an empty crate; the other holds the door with a shoulder. Their conversation travels only as far as the first tree.

orchard_rest_3.title: Under the pear trees
orchard_rest_3.text: A light in the train changes. Its reflection slides across the dark tree trunks, pauses on the packing-shed window, then moves beyond it. The driver folds her coat again and sets it beside her.

orchard_complete.title: The Quiet Orchard
orchard_complete.text: The train door opens. The handcart driver lifts a hand; the workers are still moving crates behind the trees. The orchard keeps its ordinary evening as the journey carries on.

route_callbacks.cart: The handcart driver taps the brake with her heel. The wheels settle into their grooves; she leaves the folded coat beside you.
route_callbacks.walk: The path follows the track without hurrying it. Your shoes leave a little dust on the grass at the edge.
route_callbacks.bench: The bench stays under the station awning. A porter rolls an empty trolley past, and the driver carries on tending the handcart.

camera_callbacks.take: The camera rests against your coat. The orchard goes on beyond its little glass window.
camera_callbacks.lend: The borrowed camera is still with Mira and her tools. Somewhere along the line, her own journey is continuing.
camera_callbacks.unused: The unopened camera stays in your pocket. The pear trees shift in the ordinary evening light.
